assertions.description: congestionControl is a readonly accessor: a getter with no setter on the prototype.
A session constructed without the option reports congestionControl "default".
The attribute is resolved in the constructor and readable synchronously, before any connection establishes.
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||!('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype))return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never',{congestionControl:'throughput'});t.closed.catch(()=>{});const v=t.congestionControl;try{t.close();}catch(e){}return typeof v==='string' && ['default','throughput','low-latency'].includes(v);})()

assertions.description: Requesting "throughput" yields either "throughput" (satisfied) or "default" (not satisfied) — never anything else.
Requesting "low-latency" yields either "low-latency" (satisfied) or "default" (not satisfied) — never anything else.
A value outside the WebTransportCongestionControl enum makes the constructor throw TypeError (WebIDL enum conversion).
assertions.test: (()=>{if(typeof WebTransport!=='function')return false;try{const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never',{congestionControl:'bogus'});t.closed.catch(()=>{});try{t.close();}catch(e){}return false;}catch(e){return e instanceof TypeError;}})()

assertions.description: Writing to the readonly attribute in strict mode throws TypeError on a supporting build.
assertions.test: (()=>{'use strict';if(typeof WebTransport!=='function'||!('congestionControl' in WebTransport.prototype))return false;const t=new WebTransport('https://127.0.0.1:44443/never');t.closed.catch(()=>{});let threw=false;try{t.congestionControl='throughput';}catch(e){threw=e instanceof TypeError;}try{t.close();}catch(e){}return threw;})()
